act.long_title: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence.

section.heading: Character as affecting damages
section.html: In civil cases, the fact that the character of any person is such as to affect the amount of damages which he ought to receive, is relevant. Explanation. ––In sections 52, 53, 54 and 55, the word “character” includes both reputation and disposition; but, [except as provided in section 54], evidence may be given only of general reputation and general disposition, and not of particular acts by which reputation or disposition were shown. PART II ON PROOF CHAPTER III. –– FACTS WHICH NEED NOT BE PROVED
